task: Expose backend GITLAB/JIRA/CONFLUENCE_OAUTH_ENABLED env booleans to the frontend via the existing customer-config GET /v1/config runtime bridge and hide each provider's 'Use OAuth 2.0 sign-in' toggle when its flag is off.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: customer_config runtime config (BE), featureFlags constants, integration constants (OAUTH_VARIANT_FEATURE_FLAG), useFeatureFlags hooks, featureFlags utils, SettingsForm integration form
component_scope.layers: Backend runtime-config service, API config bridge (GET /v1/config), frontend shared feature-flag infra (constants/hooks/utils), frontend UI

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Fully specified — three named env flags mapped 1:1 to three UI providers; the only design choice (fold the OAuth gate into the existing variant-flag lookup) is already resolved by the established OAUTH_VARIANT pattern

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Gates visibility of OAuth 2.0 sign-in in the UI (authorization-adjacent surface); no authz enforcement logic changed — backend routers already 503 on the same flags
technical_risk.mitigation: Purely additive, env-flag driven, trivially reversible; enforcement stays server-side; covered by new SettingsForm.oauth and customer_config tests

key_reasoning.reason: Six components across two codebases — backend runtime config plus shared frontend feature-flag constants/hooks/utils and the SettingsForm UI; touches shared frontend feature-flag utilities (additively)
10 files changed (9 modified, 1 new) spanning both the backend and UI repos; +177/-3, dominated by additive flag wiring and tests

Base risk low (reuses the env->/v1/config runtime-config pattern and the existing useFeatureFlag path), bumped one tier for OAuth sign-in exposure touching the authorization surface; enforcement remains server-side and the change is env-flag reversible

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S to M: gates OAuth 2.0 sign-in exposure (authorization-adjacent surface)
